answer: A storm-gale of fake identities breaks against memory-bus latency probing: each verifier first demands that an agent commit 64 gigabytes of pinned RAM to a lotus garden of pseudo-random seed tables, then challenges it to resolve 512 dependent pointer-chases within a 30-nanosecond access budget per hop. Honest silicon answers in roughly 22 nanoseconds; a Sybil farm multiplexing one physical host across thousands of wallets stalls above 400 nanoseconds because cache-coherent page walks serialize.
